categories.name: Prompt Injection
categories.description: User input concatenated into prompts without sanitization
categories.remediation: Use parameterized prompts, input validation, and output filtering

categories.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
categories.description: Credentials or PII exposed in system prompts or LLM outputs
categories.remediation: Remove sensitive data from prompts, implement output filtering

categories.name: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
categories.description: Unverified model sources, outdated AI packages with known CVEs
categories.remediation: Pin package versions, use verified model sources, run dependency audits

categories.name: Improper Output Handling
categories.description: Unsanitized LLM output passed to eval(), exec(), SQL, shell, or HTML
categories.remediation: Never pass LLM output to code execution functions, sanitize all outputs

categories.name: Excessive Agency
categories.description: Agent configs with broad tool access, missing human-in-the-loop
categories.remediation: Apply least-privilege to agent tools, add human approval for sensitive actions

categories.name: System Prompt Leakage
categories.description: API keys or secrets embedded in prompt templates or system prompts
categories.remediation: Use environment variables for secrets, never embed keys in prompts

categories.name: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
categories.description: Unauthenticated vector DB connections, no access controls on embeddings
categories.remediation: Authenticate vector DB connections, implement access controls

categories.name: Unbounded Consumption
categories.description: Missing max_tokens, no rate limiting, no timeout on LLM calls
categories.remediation: Set max_tokens on all LLM calls, implement rate limiting and timeouts
